# Related Backblaze B2 sample applications

The [`backblaze-b2-samples`](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples) and [`backblaze-labs`](https://github.com/backblaze-labs) organizations contain applications that complement these reference architectures. The projects below demonstrate specific curation, training, distribution, generation, moderation and delivery patterns on B2.

## Selection guidance

- Select a sample based on the required workflow and data formats.
- Keep key scoping, retention, purge and provenance decisions in this repository's architecture documents.
- Use the architecture's manifest and prefix requirements for published data.
- Configure authentication, tenant isolation, scoped credentials, retention, and recovery for the deployment.
